title: One Shared LoRA Weight for MRI Reconstruction across Acceleration Factors
abstract: arXiv:2609.06338v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accelerated MRI reconstruction recovers images from undersampled k-space. However, different acceleration factors produce distinct artifact patterns. Existing methods often train separate models for each factor, leading to poor cross-factor generalization and high training and storage costs. We propose Shared LoRA, a parameter-efficient framework that freezes the pretrained SHFormer backbone and trains a single shared set of LoRA adapters together with a lightweight gating network. During training, undersampled inputs are generated by randomly sampling acceleration factors and their corresponding sampling masks, enabling the shared adapters to learn reconstruction knowledge across factors. Given the acceleration factor, GateNet generates layer-wise coefficients to dynamically modulate the residual strength of each adapter. translated_title: 单一共享LoRA权重实现跨加速因子的MRI重建
translated_abstract: 加速MRI重建旨在从欠采样的k空间数据中恢复图像。然而，不同的加速因子会产生不同的伪影模式。现有方法通常针对每个加速因子训练单独的模型，导致跨因子泛化能力差，且训练和存储成本高昂。我们提出了Shared LoRA，一个参数高效的框架，它冻结预训练的SHFormer骨干网络，训练单一共享的LoRA适配器集合，并配合一个轻量级的门控网络。在训练过程中，通过随机采样加速因子及其对应的采样掩码来生成欠采样输入，使共享适配器能够学习跨因子的重建知识。给定加速因子后，GateNet生成逐层系数，动态调节每个适配器的残差强度。实验表明，Shared LoRA在各加速因子下取得了最佳或具有竞争力的PSNR和SSIM，同时…
tldr: 提出Shared LoRA参数高效框架，通过冻结预训练SHFormer骨干、训练单一共享的LoRA适配器与轻量级门控网络GateNet，实现跨多个加速因子的MRI重建，在保持最佳或竞争力的重建质量的同时大幅降低训练与存储成本。
en_tdlr: Proposes a parameter-efficient Shared LoRA framework that freezes the pretrained SHFormer backbone and trains a single shared set of LoRA adapters with a lightweight GateNet, enabling MRI reconstruction across multiple acceleration factors with best-or-competitive quality while greatly reducing training and storage costs.
